spark_open.description: The image shows a single quadrupedal animal standing in right-facing profile on a small patch of dirt with a few pebbles, dry leaves and tufts of grass. Its overall body proportions, head shape, legs and hooves are those of a horse or pony, with short brown fur on the head, lower legs and underparts and a lighter tan or off-white color on the muzzle, throat, chest and belly. Most of the dorsal and lateral surfaces including the back, sides, neck, forehead, upper portions of all four legs, and the long thick tapering tail are densely covered in overlapping brown keratinous scales with lighter tan edges arranged in diagonal rows, resembling a pangolin. The scales form a crest along the dorsal midline of the neck where a mane would be and a cap over the forehead between the ears. The head is horse-like with a dark eye, large nostril, closed mouth with whiskers, and two upright pointed ears. The lower legs are furry and end in solid rounded hooves. No wings, horns, or additional appendages are visible.

meta_spark.description: A horse-sized four-legged animal standing in right profile on a small patch of ground. It has the head, upright ears, slender legs and single-toed hooves of a brown horse, with brown fur on the face, front of the neck, chest, belly and lower legs.
